summary: Master Revenue Operations Training to improve CRM governance, forecasting, and workflow design. Build practical RevOps tools and apply them at work.
lede: Aligning sales, marketing and customer success around shared processes, data and reporting is the work of revenue operations. For professionals in revenue, sales, marketing or customer success operations, CRM administration, and commercial leadership, the course develops practical ways to assess current processes and improve cross-functional workflows. Learners practice auditing CRM data, mapping lead and customer handoffs, analyzing funnel conversion and pipeline velocity, and designing KPI scorecards and dashboards.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who work in revenue operations, sales operations, marketing operations, customer success operations, CRM administration, and commercial leadership. It fits intermediate learners who already touch revenue data, workflow design, or reporting and want to improve how those functions operate together.
prerequisites: Bring a laptop, a spreadsheet tool, and working familiarity with revenue processes, CRM terms, and basic KPI reporting. If your organization uses HubSpot, Salesforce, or a similar CRM, you can apply the exercises more directly, but the course also works with generic sample datasets and templates.
